# The Sports Grill

> Old-school bar and grill on Austell Rd in Austell, GA. Wings, steak, pool and TVs for the game. Rated 4.1 from 723 Google reviews.

- Type: Bar & Grill
- Address: 3999 Austell Rd Ste 806, Austell, GA 30106, USA
- Phone: (770) 739-1130

- Google rating: 4.1 from 723 reviews

## About
The Sports Grill sits on Austell Rd in Austell, and it's the kind of place where you'll find lots of regulars. One reviewer called it an old school bar, not superficial or VIP anything.
We're known for our wings, and the menu runs from pub eats to steak and Cajun prime rib bites. Grab a seat, catch the game on one of the TVs, or shoot a round of pool.
We stay open late. Come hang out and grab a bite.

## Services
- Wings: The wings are what the place is known for.
- Steak: One reviewer came in after hearing about the steak and found it juicy and well seasoned.
- Cajun prime rib bites: A reviewer favorite from the menu.
- Daily specials: Ask what's on special today.

## FAQ
Q: How late are you open?
A: Monday hours are 11 AM to 2 AM, and we keep late hours through the week.

Q: Is there parking?
A: Yes. A reviewer mentioned there's plenty of parking.

Q: Is the bar smoky?
A: People do smoke here, and one reviewer noted the bar area gets smoky, so keep that in mind if smoke bothers you.

## What customers say
- "I decided to give this place a try after getting word on how good the Steak was and man I wasn’t disappointed. It was juicy and perfectly seasoned.  I’ll definitely be making a return trip soon" (Devon T., 5/5)
- "Whenever we sit at a table it always takes a long time to get initial service…way longer than it should be but we are patient because we know the food is so good! Once we actually get service our waitresses are usually very good & attentive after that. If we sit at bar we get helped faster but it’s so smoky at bar. Miss Pam, 1 of the bartenders is my favorite! They have awesome daily specials & the Cajun prime rib bites are amazing too. Few pool tables & a vibe similar to a cheers bar, lots of regulars. Plenty of parking." (Author Shavonne L. Jackson, 4/5)
- "I'm not a fan of the super large wings but they were ok. The service was excellent.  Day bartender was super nice.  The people are always nice.  It's an old schoo bar. Not superficial or VIP this or that.  I don't care for the smoking but smokers are good drinking buddies." (LaBarron Simmons, 4/5)
- "Don't get me wrong, we love this place but $21 for 2 boston lagers is kinda nuts. Food is phenomenal and keeps me coming back to try something new. If I knew my beers would be so expensive I would've changed it up. Overall great place to hang out and grab a bite to eat." (Tyler Carter, 4/5)
